hints.content: If  $\dfrac{1}{3}$ of the contaminants are filtered out each hour, that means $\dfrac{2}{3}$ of the contaminants remain each hour.
So each hour, the amount of contaminants is multiplied by a factor of $\dfrac{2}{3}$.

If we start with the initial amount, $\dfrac12$ kilogram, and keep multiplying by $\dfrac{2}{3}$, this function gives us the remaining amount of contaminants $t$ hours after Nana started purifying the water:

$C(t)=\dfrac12\left(\dfrac{2}{3}\right)^t$
